Name: Mode
Description: Specifies the method used to match the height of the current terrain to a reference terrain. Determines how the height adjustment is performed.

Flubs.Name: Height
Flubs.Description: Directly matches the height values of the current terrain to the reference terrain, aligning elevation point-for-point.

Flubs.Name: Histogram
Flubs.Description: Matches the height distribution (histogram) of the current terrain to that of the reference terrain, preserving relative features while adjusting overall elevation statistics.
